description: YHPUgrout-2104 is a single component, self-leveling, premium grade polyurethane sealant for permanently sealing horizontal cracks.
whereToUse: It is used to seal horizontal cracks up to 25 mm wide in concrete and cementitious slabs
driveways, garages, sidewalks, balconies, terraces, decks, walkways, steps
advantages: Elastic technology allows for crack movement.
Paintable with water-based, oil-based or rubber-based paints.
Can be applied to green/new concrete 72 hours after cure.
notFor: Allow 1 week cure at standard conditions prior to painting.
Maximum exposure level of chlorine is 5 ppm.
Maximum expansion and contraction should not exceed 25 % of average joint width.
Do not cure in the presence of curing silicone sealants.
Avoid contact with alcohol and other solvent cleaners during cure.
Do not apply when moisture-vapor-transmission condition exists from the substrate as this can cause bubbling within the sealant.
To avoid bubbling, do not apply when ambient air and substrate temperatures exceed 38℃.
Do not use in contact with bituminous / asphaltic materials.
Do not use paints which are silicone based or have a high solvent content.
Avoid solvent-based and alcohol-based primers, stains, sealers and coatings.

technicalData.label: Joint size, maximum
technicalData.value: Maximum sealant depth is 12.5 mm and width is 25 mm

technicalData.label: Joint size, minimum
technicalData.value: Minimum depth is 6 mm and width is 6 mm

storage: It should be stored in a cool, ventilated, and dry warehouse, and kept away from fire sources.
